newsitem.title: USA: Europa sees Q1 profit of $600,000.
newsitem.headline: Europa sees Q1 profit of $600,000.

text.p: Europa Cruises Corp said Thursday it expects to report one of its best first quarters ever.
Net income after preferred dividends is expected to be about $600,000, compared with a net loss after preferred dividends of $201,341 a year ago.
Revenue is expected to exceed $5.8 million, up from $4.5 million during the same period in 1996.
The company said net income would have been $700,000 if not for costs incurred with respect to a proxy contest.
The company expects to report first quarter results on or about April 7.

Lester Bullock, president of Europa Cruises, commenting on the expected results, said, "The cruise division is continuing to improve and move forward based on the operating plan set by current management. The first quarter 1997 result is the report card for the cost-cutting measures implemented in late 1995 and 1996, and demonstrates the ability of the company to achieve success in a highly competitive market."
Europa Cruises is one of the largest off-shore gaming operators in the United States.
